cp12:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Bhūridatto mah' iddhiko Virūpakkhena mahāraññā devalokam-agañch' ahaṃ. || ||
cp12:2.1: Tattha passitva' haṃ deve ekantaṃ sukhasamappite taṃ saggaṃ gamana 'tthāya sīlabbataṃ samādiyiṃ. || ||
cp12:3.1: Sarīrakiccaṃ katvāna bhutvā yāpanamattakaṃ caturo aṅge adhiṭṭhāya semi vammikamuddhani. || ||
cp12:4.1: Chaviyā cammena maṃsena nahāru- aṭṭhikehi vā yassa etena karaṇīyaṃ dinnaṃ-yeva harātu so. || ||
cp12:5.1: Saṃsito akataññunā ālambāno mam-aggahi peḷāya pakkhipitvāna kīḷeti maṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ. || ||
cp12:6.1: Peḷāya pakkhipante pi sammaddante pi pāṇinā ālambāne na kuppāmi sīlakhaṇḍabhayā mama. || ||
cp12:7.1: Sakajīvitapariccāgo tiṇato lahuko mama sīlavītikkamo mayhaṃ paṭhavi- uppatanā viya. || ||
cp12:8.1: Nirantaraṃ jātisataṃ cajeyyaṃ mama jīvitam n' eva sīlam-pabhindeyyaṃ catudīpāna hetu pi. || ||
cp12:9.1: Api cāhaṃ sīlarakkhāya sīlapāramipūriyā na karomi citte aññathattaṃ pakkhipantam-pi peḷake 'ti. || ||
